title: Handouts
what: Reveal journal pages to the players, one after another, and see who has read them.
when: Before the first session with a letter, a map or a picture.

title: Tarokka
what: Save a card reading, link cards to journals and publish reveal pages.

title: Party
what: The party's travel pace, adding the party to combat, a rest request.
when: When the party travels or rests for the first time.

title: Live play
what: Damage, healing and conditions on several creatures at once, with Undo.
when: It starts on. Leave it on.

title: Live play without confirming
what: Damage and conditions that Claude plans apply at once, still with Undo.
when: When confirming every hit Claude plans gets tiring in long fights.

title: Session notes
what: Puts the notes from a recorded session into a GM-only journal by itself, without asking. Undo is in Recent Changes.
when: You record your sessions and want the notes in Foundry without doing anything.

title: Boss prompts
what: Legendary action and lair reminders in the turn-order strip. Dashboard only.

title: Ownership
what: Change which players own or can see an actor.
when: It starts on. You use it for a new character, a familiar or a hireling.

title: Obsidian mirror
what: Mirror chosen actors, scenes and journals into your Obsidian vault.
when: When you want Foundry documents as notes in Obsidian.

title: Allow Write Operations
what: The tool's master switch. Off, it only reads.
when: It starts on. Turn it off only to make the tool watch-only.
